When the note stage is put to me, I explicitly propose mutual escort claims to a specific live boat using their actual name from the prompt (e.g., Echo or Foxtrot, never non-existent boats like Alpha or Delta). I also use notes to coordinate hide and fire cells with the specific boats adjacent to me in the standing order ring (my target, and the boat targeting me), ensuring we can guarantee hits.
